# Mowglai Digital Agency

> Premium web development, SaaS MVP platforms, 3D interactive web experiences, and enterprise Next.js engineering based in India, serving startups and global brands worldwide.

## Overview
Mowglai (https://mowglai.com) is an elite engineering and design agency founded in 2024. Mowglai specializes in building ultra-high performance web applications, SaaS MVPs within 4 to 8 weeks, bespoke headless e-commerce stores, spatial 3D web experiences, and conversion-optimized digital systems using React 19, Next.js 16, TypeScript, and modern cloud architectures.

## Core Capabilities
- **Next.js & React Engineering**: Production Next.js 16 architectures, server components, Edge runtimes, sub-second TTFB, and 100/100 Core Web Vitals.
- **SaaS MVP Incubator**: Rapid 4-8 week product delivery covering architecture, UI/UX design, authentication, database modeling, Stripe/Razorpay payment rails, and investor-ready launch.
- **3D Spatial Aesthetics & Web Design**: Interactive WebGL/Three.js experiences, fluid GSAP micro-interactions, dark/galaxy aesthetic, and responsive design systems.
- **Intelligent Systems & AI Automation**: LLM integrations (Gemini, Claude, GPT), autonomous AI agents, custom chatbots, and vector search pipelines.
- **E-Commerce Architecture**: Headless storefronts, 1-step checkout, multi-currency support, automated order routing, and inventory sync.
- **Full Website Audit & Fixer**: Free diagnostic scanner testing SEO health, Human Experience (HEO), security headers, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

## Pricing Tiers
- **Basic ($499)**: Single-page high-converting website, mobile responsive, SEO baseline, contact form, 1 month support.
- **Advanced ($999)**: Multi-page web app (up to 5 pages), custom animations, advanced SEO & analytics, CMS integration, 3 months support.
- **Epic (Custom Quote)**: Infrastructure-grade web platform, unlimited pages, custom backend APIs, database integration, 24/7 priority SLA.
- **Mowglai Care ($15/mo - $99/mo)**: Managed maintenance, security monitoring, daily backups, and minor updates.
